_meta.description: Whether the customer's identity was verified, how and when (PqWerkplekKlant 'Wie is het': Gecontroleerd, Bron). Sorted after 94-client-number-and-source, so its client version (1.4.0) wins.

identityVerifiedAt.title: Identity verified at
identityVerifiedAt.description: When the customer's identity was last verified, for example by a lookup in the population register.

identityVerifiedVia.title: Identity verified via
identityVerifiedVia.description: The source the identity was verified against, such as BRP.

identityCheck.title: Identity check
identityCheck.description: What the employee checked with the customer, such as their date of birth and address.
